reference_sql:
SELECT category_id, product_id, launch_date,
       NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY launch_date NULLS LAST, product_id) AS launch_quartile
FROM products
WHERE category_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6
alternatives:
WITH numbered AS (  -- one row per product, numbered within its category in the quartile order
  SELECT category_id, product_id, launch_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY launch_date NULLS LAST, product_id) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id) AS n
  FROM products
  WHERE category_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6
),
sized AS (  -- one row per product, with its category's base quartile size q and the remainder r
  SELECT category_id, product_id, launch_date, rn, (n - n % 4) / 4 AS q, n % 4 AS r
  FROM numbered
)
SELECT category_id, product_id, launch_date,
       CASE WHEN rn <= r * (q + 1) THEN CEIL(rn * 1.0 / (q + 1))
            ELSE r + CEIL((rn - r * (q + 1)) * 1.0 / q) END AS launch_quartile
FROM sized

SELECT p.category_id, p.product_id, p.launch_date,
       NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY p.category_id ORDER BY p.launch_date ASC NULLS LAST, p.product_id ASC) AS launch_quartile
FROM products p
WHERE p.category_id IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)

other_way.sql:

  SELECT category_id, product_id, launch_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY launch_date NULLS LAST, product_id) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id) AS n
  FROM products
  WHERE category_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6
),
sized AS (  -- one row per product, with its category's base quartile size q and the remainder r
  SELECT category_id, product_id, launch_date, rn, (n - n % 4) / 4 AS q, n % 4 AS r
  FROM numbered
)
SELECT category_id, product_id, launch_date,
       CASE WHEN rn <= r * (q + 1) THEN CEIL(rn * 1.0 / (q + 1))
            ELSE r + CEIL((rn - r * (q + 1)) * 1.0 / q) END AS launch_quartile
FROM sized
other_way.tradeoff: Working the quartile out from ROW_NUMBER and the count shows how NTILE sizes its groups, but NTILE does it in one call.
